subject: planner: use logical output cols to record positions of tables to be deleted (#54010)
summary: Reviewed diff vs first parent in `pkg/planner/core/logical_plan_builder.go` around `buildDelete()`: it resolves handle column indices against the logical plan schema (`p.Schema()`) and builds `TblColPosInfos` before `DoOptimize`, instead of using `del.SelectPlan.Schema()` post-optimization. Checked surrounding helpers (`resolveIndicesForTblID2Handle`, `buildColumns2Handle`) and executor consumption (`DeleteExec` uses `TblColPosInfos` as ordinal ranges + handle indices) to ensure the recorded ordinals remain aligned with the logical output ordering. No plausible remaining Blocker/High issues found in planner correctness/semantics/consistency for this change.
